svg.title: 树麻雀：照片引导的 SVG 重建
svg.desc: Photo-guided illustration by ScanSci, CC BY 4.0. Based on Laitche's public-domain photograph Tree Sparrow August 2007 Osaka Japan.jpg from Wikimedia Commons. Native vector reconstruction of the visible right-facing bird; background and stone omitted, feather texture simplified. Sex, age and subspecies unassigned.
